answer: Twenty-eight knolls rise in a river delta; each hides one jade token, block-and-key seeded, no token repeats. A claimant surveys one knoll in a shared twenty-minute window, mapping its jade vein while three strangers watch, two knolls each. Entry locks 85 POA, +45 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,875 POA. One operator surveys two knolls at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten surveys, thirty signatures, fifteen strangers at once. A missed survey burns 25; one token found at two knolls voids both bonds. Survey times match funding roots; one hand keeps one claim.
